# Non-loopback listeners a fresh Lucciola install is expected to have,
# "proto port", one per line. Anything else listening on a non-loopback
# address fails the security smoke probe. Each line needs a reason.
#
# systemd-resolved LLMNR (Fedora default; decision D3 in docs/SECURITY-CLAIMS.md)
tcp 5355
udp 5355
# avahi-daemon mDNS (printer and device discovery)
udp 5353
